<title level="1" right="Trait">[Tripkee](/Traits.aspx?ID=793)</title>

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 221

A creature with this trait is a member of the tripkee ancestry. Tripkees are a family of frog-like humanoids. An ability with this trait can be used or selected only by tripkees. An item with this trait is created and used by tripkees.
name: Tripkee
